subject.title: fix(ai): bound openai-chatgpt-responses WebSocket with handshakeTimeout and maxPayload

question: Should this provider adopt the proposed 30-second handshake and 25 MiB payload limits, or use provider-specific values supported by OpenAI protocol evidence?
rationale: The need for finite limits is source-supported, but the payload ceiling affects availability and resource-exhaustion behavior and should match legitimate provider traffic.

options.title: Verify and add provider limits
options.body: Confirm the OpenAI frame-size contract, then add a finite handshake timeout and the smallest safe payload ceiling with behavioral tests.

options.title: Use shared repository limits
options.body: Apply the existing repository-wide WebSocket values if maintainers confirm those values are the intended cross-provider contract.

options.title: Limit handshake only
options.body: Bound the upgrade wait now and defer maxPayload until legitimate OpenAI response-frame sizes are established.

recommendation.title: Verify and add provider limits
recommendation.body: Confirm the OpenAI frame-size contract, then add a finite handshake timeout and the smallest safe payload ceiling with behavioral tests.

likelyOwner.reason: This is the strongest available routing candidate for recent AI provider package behavior and the cross-provider limit decision.
